# Hayden Baxter

> Global business leader, AI strategy partner, and WorldPulse founder working across AI systems, Digital Product Passports, global supply chains, traceability, and cross-cultural operations.

Hayden Baxter helps organizations turn emerging technology into practical
products, smarter operations, and more transparent supply chains. He is the
founder of WorldPulse (worldxpulse.com), which develops Digital Product Passport
technology for supply chain transparency.

Canonical origin: https://www.haydenbaxter.com

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/): Overview of Hayden Baxter's work, experience, and capabilities. Note that the Work section is an interactive, client-rendered experience; the summaries on this page describe the same material.
- [Emerging Tech Builds](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds): AI and emerging technology product portfolio, with front-end builds and concept-stage explorations listed side by side.
- [Journal](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/blog): Writing on AI, supply chains, sustainability, and product building.

## Projects

- [Cortex](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds/cortex): An editorial research system that connects sources, notes, claims, topic maps, and drafts, reasons across the whole knowledge base, and keeps answers tied to their sources. Front-end build.
- [AtomicOS](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds/atomic-os): A personal operating system for habits and daily execution. Natural-language check-ins turn everyday behavior into structured data, and a dashboard surfaces patterns in energy, focus, and follow-through. Front-end build.
- [CaseBrief](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/emerging-tech-builds/casebrief): Case-intelligence tooling that turns scattered medical records into a clear, source-backed injury narrative, flags records referenced but missing from a file, and keeps each conclusion tied to its source document and page. Front-end build.

## Writing

- [3 Takeaways from Innovation Forum's Sustainable Apparel & Textiles Conference](https://www.haydenbaxter.com/blog/3-takeaways-from-innovation-forum-s-sustainable-apparel-textiles-conference): Shared responsibility across apparel supply chains, Digital Product Passports as a new layer of digital real estate on physical products, and the case for a stronger business rationale for sustainability. Published July 29, 2026.

## Notes

- Contact runs through the Connect section on the homepage. No contact details are listed here.
- The various *-lab, *-sandbox, and *-preview paths are internal or experimental. They are excluded from the sitemap and disallowed in robots.txt.
- Project status labels ("Front-end Build", "Concept") are accurate as written; the concept-stage projects have no working implementation.
